3875-5702-6973-8345.easyPrerequisites:
You have a land card in hand.
You are able to play a land this turn.
3875-5702-6973-8345.description:
Play a land.
When the land enters, Springheart Nantuko triggers, causing you to pay {1}{G} to create a token copy of Mutable Explorer.
When the Mutable Explorer token enters, it triggers, creating a Mutavault land token that enters untapped due to Warp Speed.
When the Mutavault token enters, Springheart Nantuko and Tireless Provisioner trigger.
Holding priority, activate the Mutavault token by tapping it, adding {C}.
Resolve the Tireless Provisioner trigger, creating a Treasure token.
Activate the Treasure by tapping and sacrificing it, adding {G}
Resolve the Springheart Nantuko trigger, causing you to pay {1}{G} to create a token copy of Mutable Explorer.
Repeat from step 3.

requires.n: Effects that Alter a Creature's Power/Toughness (Anthem Effects)

2034-4550-5567-8298--112.easyPrerequisites: You have two or more cards in hand.
2034-4550-5567-8298--112.description:
Activate Zombie Infestation by discarding two cards, creating a 2/2 Zombie creature token.
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing the Zombie, whose power should have been altered from its base power.
When the Zombie dies, Jason Bright triggers, causing you to draw two cards.
Repeat.

751-4289-7297.description:
Cast Shrieking Drake by paying {U}.
When Shrieking Drake enters, it triggers.
Holding priority, activate Shrieking Drake by tapping it, adding {U}.
Resolve the Shrieking Drake ability, returning it from the battlefield to your hand.
Repeat.

1981-5147-7399.easyPrerequisites:
You control an additional creature.
Your life total is at least 2.
1981-5147-7399.description:
Activate Goblin Bombardment by sacrificing any other creature you control, dealing 1 damage to yourself.
Darien triggers, causing you to create a 1/1 Soldier creature token.
When the Soldier enters, Bogwater Lumaret triggers, causing you to gain 1 life.
Repeat.

645-914-3750-4247.notablePrerequisites:
Alesha does not have summoning sickness.
An opponent cannot block and kill creatures you control.
Opponents control at least seven artifacts and/or enchantments.
645-914-3750-4247.description:
Declare Alesha as an attacker.
Alesha triggers, causing you to pay {W/B}{W/B} to return Dockside Extortionist from your graveyard to the battlefield tapped and attacking.
When Dockside Extortionist enters the battlefield, it triggers, creating at least seven Treasure tokens.
Move to your postcombat main phase.
Activate Bloodthrone Vampire by sacrificing Dockside Extortionist
Activate five Treasures by tapping and sacrificing them, adding {3}{R}{R}.
Activate Aggravated Assault by paying {3}{R}{R}, causing you to untap all creatures you control and to get an additional combat and main phase after this one.
Move to your next combat phase.
Declare Alesha as an attacker.
Alesha triggers, holding priority, activate two Treasures by tapping and sacrificing them, adding {W/B}{W/B}.
Resolve the Alesha trigger, causing you to pay {W/B}{W/B} to return Dockside Extortionist from your graveyard to the battlefield tapped and attacking.
Repeat from step 3.

348-1116-1152-3191-7548.easyPrerequisites: You control at least one additional creature.
348-1116-1152-3191-7548.description:
Cast Traitorous Greed by paying {3}{R}.
Forum Necroscribe triggers, returning Kairi from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Resolve Traitorous Greed, untapping Priest of the Forgotten Gods, giving it haste until end of turn, and adding {R}{R}.
Activate Priest of the Forgotten Gods by tapping it, sacrificing Kairi and any creature not part of the combo.
When Kairi dies, it and Sek'Kuar triggers.
Resolve the Kairi trigger, returning Traitorous Greed from your graveyard to your hand.
Resolve the Sek'Kuar trigger, creating a creature token.
Resolve the Priest of the Forgotten Gods ability, causing any number of opponents to sacrifice a creature and lose 2 life, adding {B}{B}, and drawing a card.
Repeat, sacrificing the newly created token in step 4 instead of the additional creature.

2043-7175-7826.description:
Activate Urza by paying {6}, creating a token copy of Bag End Banquet that is a 1/1 Soldier in addition to its other types.
When the Bag End Banquet token enters, it triggers, creating three Food tokens.
Activate the Bag End Banquet token by tapping it, adding {C} for each Food you control.
Repeat
2043-7175-7826.notes: You can reduce the cost by up to {3} if you control additional Food(s) as you start the combo. You can also tap the original Bag End Banquet for mana after the Foods are created initially if you're able to do so.

215-1115-3443.notablePrerequisites: You have at least seven creature cards in your graveyard.
215-1115-3443.description:
Activate Deathbloom Ritualist by tapping it, adding an amount of {B} or {G}.
Activate Temur Sabertooth by paying {1}{G}, returning Deathbloom Ritualist from the battlefield to your hand.
Cast Deathbloom Ritualist by paying its mana cost.
Repeat.
215-1115-3443.notes: Alternate the colors of mana you add each time. If you start adding {B}, you need {G} for Temur Sabertooth and {G} to cast Deathbloom Ritualist

5147-6248-7084.easyPrerequisites:
You control a land.
You control another nonland creature.
5147-6248-7084.description:
Activate Goblin Bombardment by sacrificing another nonland creature.
When the creature dies, Beifong's Bounty Hunters triggers, earthbending a land you control.
Resolve the Goblin Bombardment ability.
Activate Goblin Bombardment by sacrificing the earthbent land.
When the land dies, Phenomenon Investigators and Beifong's Bounty Hunters trigger.
Resolve the Beifong's Bounty Hunters trigger, returning the land from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Resolve the Phenomenon Investigators trigger, creating a creature token.
Resolve the Goblin Bombardment ability.
Repeat.

uses.n: Eirdu, Carrier of Dawn // Isilu, Carrier of Twilight

2438-4585-6972.description:
Activate Carrion Feeder by sacrificing Custodi Soulbinders.
When Custodi Soulbinders dies, its persist ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield without a -1/-1 counter on it due to its replacement effect.
Resolve the Carrion Feeder ability.
Repeat.

2034-5003-7177.description:
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing Elder Auntie, adding {C}{C}.
When Elder Auntie dies, Nim Deathmantle triggers, causing you to pay {4} to return Elder Auntie from your graveyard to the battlefield and attach Nim Deathmantle to it.
When Elder Auntie enters, it triggers, creating a creature token.
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing a creature token, adding {C}{C}.
Repeat.

2034-2919-5086-5183-6441.easyPrerequisites: Triskelavus has two or more +1/+1 counters on it.
2034-2919-5086-5183-6441.description:
Activate Triskelavus by paying {1} and removing a +1/+1 counter from it, creating two creature tokens.
Activate a Triskelavite token by sacrificing it, dealing 1 damage to any target and causing you to gain life.
Archangel of Thune triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on each creature you control
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing another creature token, adding {C}{C}
Repeat from step 1.

1594-2034-2048-4871-7147.description:
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing Wretched Throng, adding {C}{C}.
When Wretched Throng dies, it and Pitiless Plunderer trigger.
Holding priority, activate Epitaph Golem by paying {2}, putting Wretched Throng from your graveyard onto the bottom of your library.
Resolve the Pitiless Plunderer trigger, creating a Treasure token.
Resolve the Wretched Throng trigger, putting Wretched Throng from your library into your hand.
Activate the Treasure by tapping and sacrificing it, adding {U}.
Cast Wretched Throng by paying {U} due to Helm of Awakening.
Repeat.

uses.n: The Legend of Kuruk // Avatar Kuruk

4428-6995-7009.manaNeeded: {3}{U} plus {20} minus {1} for each creature and artifact you control each turn available
4428-6995-7009.description:
Activate Avatar Kuruk by paying {20} minus {1} for each creature and/or artifact you can tap while activating it, causing you to take an extra turn after this one.
At the beginning of your end step, Thassa triggers, blinking Avatar Kuruk and causing it to return to the battlefield as The Legend of Kuruk with a lore counter on it.
The Legend of Kuruk's first chapter ability triggers, causing you to scry 2 and draw a card.
Move to your next turn. At the beginning of your precombat main phase. The Legend of Kuruk triggers, putting a lore counter on it. Its second chapter ability then triggers, causing you to scry 2 and draw a card.
Activate Lulu by paying {3}{U}, causing you to proliferate and put a lore counter on The Legend of Kuruk.
The Legend of Kuruk's third chapter ability triggers, causing you to exile it and return it to the battlefield as Avatar Kuruk.
Repeat.

681-1669-6621-6763.easyPrerequisites: Lands you control excluding Mirrorpool can tap to produce at least {2}{C}
681-1669-6621-6763.description:
Cast Splendid Reclamation by paying {3}{G}.
Holding priority, activate any number of lands you control except Mirrorpool by tapping them, adding at least {2}{C}.
Activate Thaumatog by sacrificing a land other than Mirrorpool.
Repeat step 3 until Mirrorpool is the only land you control.
Activate Mirrorpool's second ability by paying {2}{C}, tapping and sacrificing it, copying Splendid Reclamation.
Resolve the Splendid Reclamation copy, returning all land cards from your graveyard to the battlefield untapped due to Horizon Explorer.
Repeat from step 2.

2173-3558-3967-5220.description:
Activate Yahenni by sacrificing Crookshank Kobolds
When Crookshank Kobolds dies, Mortuary triggers, putting Crookshank Kobolds from your graveyard onto the top of your library.
Resolve the Yahenni ability.
Cast Crookshank Kobolds from the top of your library by paying 0 life.
Repeat.

522-1429-2981.description:
Activate Megatog by sacrificing Lesser Masticore.
When Lesser Masticore dies, its persist ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield without a -1/-1 counter on it due to Melira.
Resolve the Megatog ability.
Repeat.

2060-3054-4050-6701.easyPrerequisites: You have gained life this turn.
2060-3054-4050-6701.description:
Cast Oathsworn Vampire from your graveyard by paying its mana cost.
Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing Oathsworn Vampire.
When Oathsworn Vampire is sacrificed, Szarel triggers, putting a number of +1/+1 counters equal to Szarel's power on Crystalline Crawler.
Activate Crystalline Crawler by removing a +1/+1 counter from it, adding {B}.
Repeat.
2060-3054-4050-6701.notes: This combo can put infinite +1/+1 counters on each creature you control except Szarel so long as its power is greater than the mana value of the card in your graveyard.

1621-4605-5895.notablePrerequisites: You have enough mana to cast Splash Portal.
1621-4605-5895.description:
Cast Splash Portal by paying its mana cost, blinking Wispweaver Angel.
Wispweaver Angel and Preston trigger.
Resolve the Wispweaver Angel trigger, blinking another creature you control.
Resolve the Preston trigger, creating a token copy of Wispweaver Angel that is a 0/1 Illusion.
When the Wispweaver Angel token enters the battlefield, it triggers, blinking the nontoken Wispweaver Angel.
Repeat from step 2.

2060-3525-3574-3921.notablePrerequisites:
Mikaeus does not have summoning sickness.
Pemmin's Aura attached to Mikaeus.
2060-3525-3574-3921.description:
Activate Mikaeus' second ability by tapping it and removing a +1/+1 counter from it, putting two +1/+1 counters on each other creature you control.
Activate Crystalline Crawler's first ability twice by removing two +1/+1 counters from it, adding {U}{U}.
Activate Pemmin's Aura by paying {U}, untapping Mikaeus.
Activate Mikaeus' first ability by tapping it, putting two +1/+1 counters on it.
Activate Pemmin's Aura by paying {U}, untapping Mikaeus.
Repeat.
2060-3525-3574-3921.notes: If Mikaeus has a +1/+1 counter on it, you may skip steps 4 and 5 during that iteration.

202-2353-6191.notablePrerequisites: You have a way to draw a card.
202-2353-6191.description:
Draw a card.
Niv-Mizzet triggers, dealing 1 damage to an opponent.
Bloodthirsty Conqueror triggers, causing you to draw a card due to Lich.
Repeat from step 2.

2757-3705-5231-5465.notablePrerequisites: You control at least one basic Mountain.
2757-3705-5231-5465.description:
Activate a basic Mountain by tapping it, adding {R}.
Activate Earthcraft by tapping Squee, untapping the Mountain.
Activate Thermopod's second ability by sacrificing Squee, adding {R}.
Cast Squee from your graveyard by paying {R}{R}.
Repeat.

457-4331-4947--44.description:
Cast the artifact by paying {0}.
Sai triggers, creating a 1/1 Thopter artifact creature token.
Activate Urza's first ability twice by tapping the nontoken artifact and the Thopter, adding {U}{U}.
Activate Drafna's first ability by paying {1}{U}, returning the nontoken artifact to your hand from the battlefield.
Repeat.

719-2395-4508-4971.notablePrerequisites:
You have a way to draw a card.
"Pirate" chosen with Xenograft.
719-2395-4508-4971.description:
Draw a card.
Niv-Mizzet triggers, dealing 1 damage to an opponent.
Malcom triggers, creating a Treasure token.
The Treasure enters the battlefield, triggering Quicksmith Genius, causing you to loot.
Repeat from step 2.

3858-4058.notablePrerequisites: There are at least nineteen cards in all graveyards.
3858-4058.description: At the beginning of your upkeep, Mayael's Aria triggers, causing you to put a +1/+1 counter on each creature you control, gain ten life, and win the game.

1409-2782-4050.notablePrerequisites:
Deadeye Navigator is paired with Nevinyrral.
At least two creatures have died this turn.
1409-2782-4050.description:
Activate Nevinyrral by paying {1}{U}, blinking itself.
Nevinyrral enters the battlefield, triggering itself and Deadeye Navigator's soulbond ability.
Resolve the Nevinyrral trigger, creating a tapped 2/2 Zombie creature token for each creature that's died this turn.
Resolve the Deadeye Navigator trigger, repairing it and Nevinyrral.
Activate Phyrexian Altar twice by sacrificing two Zombies, adding {1}{U}.
Repeat.

2645-3430-3990.notablePrerequisites:
Incubation Druid does not have summoning sickness.
Incubation Druid has at least one +1/+1 counter on it.
2645-3430-3990.description:
Activate Incubation Druid's first ability by tapping it, adding nine mana of any color a land you control could produce.
Activate Staff of Domination's third ability by paying {3} and tapping it, untapping Incubation Druid.
Activate Staff of Domination's first ability by paying {1}, untapping it.
Repeat.
Once you have infinite mana, you may use it to activate Staff of Domination's other abilities.

1283-3157-4770.description:
Activate Chromatic Orrery by tapping it, adding {C}{C}{C}{C}{C}.
Cast Whitemane Lion.
Pay for Talisman to untap Chromatic Orrery.
Return Whitemane Lion to hand using its ability.

800-4474-4893.notablePrerequisites:
Paradise Mantle attached to Knacksaw Clique.
Knacksaw Clique does not have summoning sickness.
800-4474-4893.description:
Activate Knacksaw Clique by tapping it, adding {U}.
Activate Knacksaw Clique by paying {U} and untap it, exiling the top card of target opponent's library.
Repeat.
